slides.h: Think you don't like anime? [[Wrong first show]], that's all.
slides.dek: 5 starters chosen for people who bounced off it. Send this to that friend.

slides.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
slides.why: The consensus starter. One complete story, no filler, and it sticks the landing.

slides.title: Death Note
slides.why: A cat-and-mouse thriller played like a chess match. For the Breaking Bad friend.

slides.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
slides.why: A quiet fantasy about outliving your friends, told with prestige-TV patience. For the reader.

slides.title: Vinland Saga
slides.why: Vikings, revenge, and one of the best character arcs in modern television, animated or not.

slides.title: Spy x Family
slides.why: A fake family sitcom with spy-movie polish. The easiest yes in the entire medium.

slides.body: Send them this. Then tell us which show made anime click for you.
